newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cheung Kong ups offer on Laguna Verde.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong ups offer on Laguna Verde.

text.p: Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd said it would offer an additional 200 flats in its Laguna Verde residential development in Kowloon for sale at HK$9,082 per square foot, priced two percent up from the previous batch.
Including the newly offered fourth batch, the company said it would put a total 528 units for sale on Saturday.
The company offered an initial 78 units for sale at an average price of HK$8,286 per square foot.

It raised the offer price by six percent to HK$8,787 for the second batch of 125 units, another three percent for the 125 units in the third batch, and another two percent rise for the 200 units in the fourth batch.
Cheung Kong said there were a total 14,000 potential buyers registered at the close of a five-day registration on Wednesday, or 180 times subscription for the initial 78 units on offer.
The size of the flats on offer in the development in Hunghom range from 500 to 1,500 square feet per unit.
